QUOTE: When `MBEDTLS_PLATFORM_STD_CALLOC` is not defined, the default calloc is `platform_calloc_uninit` (`platform.c:25`), which always returns NULL. A library built this way cannot allocate unless a project installs its own functions.
VERDICT: MISS
WHY: The answer covers the calloc-returns-NULL default but says nothing about the uninitialised free doing nothing, and the item requires both halves.
